name: probe 6: the same actions with a mouse at the desk

steps.label: a drag carries the cube onto the plate
the drag was not also a select
drag the bead down the screen, past 120 px
the wheel over the slip opens it
steps.eval: (() => { const p = probe.screen('probe:slip'); const c = app.world.renderer.domElement; const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); const at = { clientX: r.left + p.x, clientY: r.top + p.y, bubbles: true }; c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { ...at, pointerType: 'mouse', pointerId: 1 })); setTimeout(() => c.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { ...at, deltaY: -120 })), 100); return true; })()

steps.label: the wheel back closes it
steps.eval: (() => { const p = probe.screen('probe:slip'); const c = app.world.renderer.domElement; const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); c.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { clientX: r.left + p.x, clientY: r.top + p.y, deltaY: 120, bubbles: true })); return true; })()
